newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shrs end up, Eletrobras leads pack.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shrs end up, Eletrobras leads pack.

text.p: Shares ended up 1.71 percent in moderate trade, with state power firm Eletrobras spearheading the rise, brokers said.
The Bovespa index of the 49-most traded shares closed up 1,136 points at 67,449. Turnover was 391.8 million reais ($382.4 million).
Eletrobras preferred shares, which continued to benefit from a positive outlook for its privatization, ended up 6.52 percent at 343 reais. The common share closed at 330 reais, up 6.11 percent.

Some analysts attributed the rise on Eletrobras shares to moves by major players to raise the Bovespa index ahead of futures settlements tomorrow. They also said trading on bellwether Telebras shares was quiet to avoid hiking its price ahead of options settlements on October 21.
Telebras preferred closed at 82.30 reais, up 1.6 percent.

Traders expect the bourse to open higher on Wednesday, but some profit-taking can cut into the gains if there is a delay on a lower house committee vote on a report on the government's administrative reforms.
